brief: Map each array value through a function
description: Call callbackfn once for each entry of array, in index order from 0 through length minus one, and return a new array of the same length with the results. Entries whose value is undefined (including omitted elements in array literals) are included; callbackfn receives undefined for those indexes.

parameters.description: The array to walk. A string is not walked as an array: write [...value] to walk its characters.
parameters.name: array

parameters.dataTypeParameter: (value: any, index?: integer, array?: array) => any
parameters.description: Called for each entry of array; its result is the entry of the new array at the same index. A script function is called with (value, index, array); a built-in function is called with the value alone, since its other parameters have their own meanings.
parameters.name: callbackfn

returns.description: A new array with one result per entry of array.
